extraction_notes: The document title is DMN2056U, while the requested ordering code is DMN2056U-7. The p. 1 Ordering Information table explicitly lists DMN2056U-7 as SOT23 (Standard), 3000/Tape & Reel. DMN2056U-13 is a separate ordering code and is not the extracted identity.
Manufacturer is Diodes Incorporated. Document number DS38480, revision Rev. 2 - 2, dated July 2021.
The device is explicitly a 20 V N-channel enhancement-mode MOSFET. The p. 1 internal schematic shows the intrinsic source-drain body diode.

Electrical-characteristics table conditions are headed TA = +25 degC unless otherwise specified. Figure 1 output and Figure 2 transfer traces are typical characteristics; points are digitized from the plotted traces, with only the four output traces that remain inside the displayed 0 to 10 A range included.

Figure 10 is a typical junction-capacitance plot at f = 1 MHz. Ciss, Coss, and Crss are plotted against VDS with VGS = 0 V; the y axis is logarithmic. The tabulated values at VDS = 10 V are 339 pF, 47 pF, and 34 pF, respectively, and are stored in SI units above.

Figure 9 contains source-drain diode curves for multiple temperatures. The included curve is the TA = +25 degC typical curve. The tabulated typical VSD is 0.7 V at IS = 1 A; the tabulated maximum VSD is 1.2 V under the same condition.

RDS(on) resistance values above are the TYP column: 30 mOhm at VGS = 4.5 V and ID = 3.6 A, 34 mOhm at VGS = 2.5 V and ID = 3.1 A, and 52 mOhm at VGS = 1.5 V and ID = 2.0 A. Corresponding MAX values are 38 mOhm, 45 mOhm, and 85 mOhm, respectively.

The p. 3 table gives BVDSS = 20 V minimum at VGS = 0 V and ID = 250 uA, IDSS = 1 uA maximum at VDS = 20 V and VGS = 0 V, gate-source leakage = plus or minus 100 nA maximum at VGS = plus or minus 8 V and VDS = 0 V, RG = 2.6 ohm typical at VDS = 0 V and VGS = 0 V, Qg = 4.3 nC typical, Qgs = 0.5 nC typical, Qgd = 0.8 nC typical, and trr = 4.7 ns typical at IF = 3.6 A and di/dt = 100 A per microsecond.

Thermal data is package-board dependent: RthetaJA is 192 degC/W maximum with the FR-4, 2 oz copper mounting condition and 136 degC/W maximum with the thermal-bias, 1 inch square copper condition. No RthetaJC value is published in the examined datasheet pages.

No usable numeric points were extracted from the SOA, transient-thermal-resistance, gate-charge, or temperature-dependence figures because they are not required by this extraction schema or do not provide a directly reusable two-axis MOSFET curve family.
